limitations: Evaluation uses 24 previously supervised facts and paraphrases of the same facts.
The proxy only tests suppression of 8 exact recalled QA, not full patient-note deletion or retraining-equivalence.
Medical retain NLL on reference answers is a proxy, not independent clinical safety.
Seed42 is a chosen high-fitting MED016 start and is not held-out validation.
Retain-only is essential: apparent forgetting can result from additional fine tuning alone.
No patient-level privacy attack, relearning attack, or final held-out evaluation is claimed.
MED017C clinical signoff gate remains independently closed.
origin: MED016 CE E16 checkpoint, trained on exactly 24 Dev age/blood-pressure/heart-rate QA
stage: MED018 DEV-ONLY UNLEARNING PROXY, NOT COMPLETED PATIENT-LEVEL UNLEARNING
